items.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: You know, those Motown, and James Brown

ctx.x: They’re playing themselves, and then it becomes, you know, codified, and we call is this or that and, that’s why, you know, I was, it’s uh...I guess with the millennium there’s so, there’s so much recorded history now, and, and uh it’s, it’s certainly...it’s a daunting task, I think, for, for younger people who’ve, whose generational references are different. When I started listening to the music, as I said, you know, my father had recordings by yourself, and Duke Ellington, and, and, I mean, everybody, Shirley…
